title: Snapping
description: Make placement exact: snap angles, lengths, points, and paths — each with its own switch.

bubble.title: Snapping: placement that lands exactly
bubble.body: Snapping pulls the points you place onto exact angles, lengths, and existing geometry. Each kind has its own switch in this section — use one, or all.

bubble.title: Angle snapping
bubble.body: Switch on Angle snapping. Lines and drags now rest at 15° steps instead of almost-right angles.

bubble.title: Draw with it
bubble.body: Draw a rectangle with I: press at one corner, steer — the preview prefers exact angles — and press at the other corner to deposit.

bubble.title: Length snapping
bubble.body: Switch on Length snapping. Distances you draw now round to the length step shown beside it (10 points to start).

bubble.title: Guides snap too
bubble.body: Guides are snap targets on their own switch in this section — and hidden guides still snap, so a tidy page can keep its measurements. Path and point snapping pull new points onto existing shapes.
